categories.question: A snowstorm leaves you with a whole afternoon in a cottage. What do you do at the table?

outcomes.name: Paint wooden bird ornaments
outcomes.description: Wooden bird shapes, paintbrush and a half-painted red robin ornament

outcomes.name: Press winter leaves
outcomes.description: Small wooden flower press open around fern and ivy leaves with blotting paper

outcomes.name: Make orange-and-clove pomanders
outcomes.description: Whole orange studded in a spiral of cloves with a velvet ribbon

outcomes.name: Sort stones by torchlight
outcomes.description: Small collection of translucent agate slices on a table with light shining through one
